issue_context.title: Unable to add image + text to HTML Mesh
issue_context.body: ### Description Hi, I'm trying to embed some HTML containing both images and text into HTML Mesh and adding the group to a scene. But so far only texts appear in the mesh, not images. Does HTML Mesh support embedding images? Thank You! ### Reproduction steps 1. Create an HTML element containing images and text 2. Create an HTML mesh object using new HTMLMesh() 3. Add mesh to scene ### Code ```js const group = new InteractiveGroup( renderer, camera ); scene.add( group ); const test = document.querySelector('#test') const htmlMesh = new HTMLMesh(test) htmlMesh.scale.setScalar(10) htmlMesh.position.set(-2, 0, 0) group.add(htmlMesh) ``` ### Live example * [jsfiddle-dev](https://jsfiddle.net/jcy089/vhu8kmzt/4/) ### Screenshots ### Version r137 ### Device Mac ### Browser Safari ### OS Mac OS
comments:
In the pull request I'm seeing that the image `https://i.imgur.com/jf4lNex.png` has been successfully rendered into the HTML Mesh. 

My issue is that I'm not even seeing my image rendered at all in my example JS Fiddle. 

So does HTML Mesh support images just with some slight bugs or not at all?

No, there is no support for images.

I also wonder if the support is actually required since you could easily load the image as a normal texture and add it to a plane mesh. The mesh itself could be added as a child to your interactive group.

To clarify, `HTMLMesh` was developed so things like input fields or checkboxes can be used in XR. Using it with images seems out-of-scope.

I am using HTMLMesh inside XR, in Oculus Quest. I have some prebuilt HTML UI that is already suitable for VR and already working quite well in desktop. I'm trying not to re-create the whole UI from scratch and try to port it over to XR using HTMLMesh. 

Since there are image elements in the UI, I need to be able to load them together into HTMLMesh instead of separately as an image texture.
I understand. Maybe we can revisit #24043 and try to fix the open points.

If the image loading is fixed, will it be possible to use the new HTMLMesh.js with r137 as an add-on? The project I'm working on is using r137 and I think a lot of other elements might brake if there was a sudden migration.
Looking at the code I guess it _should_ work although there is no guarantee. We do not support such scenarios.

If the InteractiveGroup for the HTML Mesh isn't passed into the render loop, is there any method to manually update the HTML Mesh? Something like needsUpdate = true like with textures?

Since I'm not updating it often, I'd like to manually call update for new changes to the HTML.

You can manually update the HTML mesh's internal texture like so:
```js
htmlMesh.material.map.update();
```
This will trigger the `html2canvas()` routine that redraws its canvas based on the latest DOM.
Thank you, this worked great! I see that there's a new pull request, does this mean the issue has been fixed? If so, how can I download the fixed version of htmlMesh.js?

>  does this mean the issue has been fixed

Not yet. The PR has to be merged first. 

After that, the latest `dev` version can be found here: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/examples/jsm/interactive/HTMLMesh.js
Great! Is there an approximate date when the PR might be merged?

I think it's less confusing to just draw the image and not an additional path.
